requirements.statement: A shopper can sign in via SSO before browsing and shopping

criteria.must: An unauthenticated visitor is redirected to sign in before reaching the storefront
A shopper who completes sign-in is returned to the storefront as an authenticated user

requirements.statement: A shopper can browse the product catalog of handmade ceramics

criteria.must: The catalog page lists available products with name, price, and image
The catalog list is paginated when the number of products exceeds one page

requirements.statement: A shopper can view a product's details before buying

criteria.must: The product detail view shows photos, description, price, and stock availability
An out-of-stock product is clearly marked and cannot be added to the cart

requirements.statement: A shopper can search and filter the catalog

criteria.must: Searching by keyword returns only products whose name or description matches
Filtering by category returns only products in that category

requirements.statement: A shopper can add products to a cart

criteria.must: Adding a product to the cart increases the cart's item count
Adding a product beyond available stock is rejected

requirements.statement: A shopper can update quantities or remove items from the cart

criteria.must: Changing a cart item's quantity updates the cart subtotal
Removing a cart item takes it out of the cart entirely

requirements.statement: A shopper can check out and pay securely through a payment provider

criteria.must: A successful payment places an order and clears the shopper's cart
A declined payment does not create an order and leaves the cart intact
Checkout is blocked when the cart is empty

requirements.statement: A shopper receives an email confirmation after placing an order

criteria.must: An order-confirmation email is sent after a successful checkout
The confirmation email content is clear and includes the order details

requirements.statement: A shopper can view their past orders and status

criteria.must: The order history lists only orders placed by the signed-in shopper
Each listed order shows its current fulfillment status

requirements.statement: An admin can add, edit, and remove products in the catalog

criteria.must: A newly created product appears in the shopper-facing catalog
An edited product's changes are reflected in its detail view
A removed product no longer appears in the catalog
A non-admin caller cannot create, edit, or remove a product

requirements.statement: An admin can track and update inventory levels so out-of-stock products can't be bought

criteria.must: An admin can view the current stock quantity for a product
An admin can update a product's stock quantity
A product with zero stock cannot be added to a shopper's cart

requirements.statement: An admin can view incoming orders and update their fulfillment status

criteria.must: The admin orders view lists all orders across all shoppers
An admin can change an order's status to processing, shipped, or delivered
A non-admin caller cannot update an order's fulfillment status
